measured_with: tape (readings recorded in feet/inches, converted here; raw sheet: measurements_raw.txt)
resolution_note: Wall lengths were recorded to the nearest 0.5 ft (one reading each), so each wall value carries up to +-7.6 cm of reading uncertainty (+-1.2 to 2.5 % on these walls).
